AggSpec.description:
One reducer of a ``group_by().agg()``.

``col`` is null only for ``fn == "len"`` spelled bare (``pl.len()`` /
the deprecated ``pl.count()``): the group size reads no column. The
column-attached spelling ``pl.col(c).len()`` keeps ``col = c`` — Polars
still returns the group size there, but names the output after ``c``, and
a missing ``c`` still raises.

alias.description: Output column name. Polars defaults it to ``col``, except for a bare ``pl.len()`` -> 'len' and a bare ``pl.count()`` -> 'count'
alias.title: Alias

col.description: Source column reduced; null only for a bare ``len`` (group size)
col.title: Col

AggSpec.title: AggSpec

AndPred.description: ``{"and": [<Pred>, ...]}`` — the field is aliased because ``and`` is a keyword.
AndPred.title: AndPred

BindingTable.description: Everything the runtime needs to refill a ui-mode figure (RFC §4).

group_cols.description: px grouping columns in order [color, symbol, line_dash, line_group, pattern_shape, facet_row, facet_col]

sampled.description: True when the build sampled before filtering (FIGURE_MAX_POINTS) -> partial tier

scaffold.description: Full figure JSON from the real create_figure_from_data, data arrays stripped

BundledObject.description:
One object-store file shipped inside the bundle (a structure, a PAE matrix).

The runtime answers the renderer's ``GET /files/indexed/{dc_id}`` from
:class:`ObjectCollection` and hands it a ``blob:`` URL over these bytes, so
the renderer's own download path (gunzip by magic bytes, per-object cache)
runs unchanged and nothing leaves the page.

gzip.description: Bytes were gzip-compressed at export (the reader gunzips)
gzip.title: Gzip

name.description: File name as stored (format sniffing reads its extension)
name.title: Name

sample.description: Entity the file belongs to (the indexed_file sample)
sample.title: Sample

size_bytes.description: Size of the original object in bytes
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

BundledObject.title: BundledObject

value.description: JSON scalar compared against the column (never null — use is_null)
value.title: Value

CmpOperator.description: Comparison operators expressible in a prologue predicate.
CmpOperator.title: CmpOperator

ColRef.description: Argument of the unary null predicates: ``{"col": "x"}``.
ColRef.title: ColRef

ColumnSpec.description: One physical column of a bundled Parquet file.

dtype.description: Polars dtype string at export time (e.g. 'Int64', 'Utf8')
dtype.title: Dtype

name.description: Column name as stored in the Parquet file
name.title: Name

ColumnSpec.title: ColumnSpec

ComponentTier.description: Per-component liveness in the static runtime (RFC §3.2).
ComponentTier.title: ComponentTier

DashboardSection.description: The dashboard document the runtime mounts.

id.description: Dashboard id the runtime passes to App — real Mongo id (producer A/C) or synthetic sha1(workflow_tag + ':' + dc_tag)[:24]-style id (producer B). Must be non-empty: ComponentRenderer silently no-ops several component types without a dashboardId.
id.title: Id

DashboardSection.title: DashboardSection

DataRef.description:
One data collection's bundled table.

Mirrors the shape of ``load_deltatable_lite``'s ``init_data`` entries
(``deltatables_utils.py:1393``) — the proven "resolve a DC without an API
round-trip" contract — extended with serverless-only fields.

aggregation_hash.description: Staleness token: server-side _get_aggregation_hash for producer A, hash of the input Parquet bytes for producer B
aggregation_hash.title: Aggregation Hash

codebooks.description: Per categorical non-String column: JSON-serialized option value -> integer code stored in the '__code__<col>' companion. Keys are serialized with the same _json_safe path that produces MultiSelect options, so option values and codebook keys are byte-identical. A selected value absent from the codebook matches nothing (same as a failed cast server-side).
codebooks.title: Codebooks

companions.description: Companion column name -> source. '__ts__<col>': epoch-microsecond datetime companion for <col>; '__fe__<sha8>': boolean column for the component-static filter_expr whose source text is the value; '__code__<col>': Int32 codebook codes for categorical column <col>.
companions.title: Companions

row_group_bytes.description: Target row-group size used at export (tuned for Range requests in remote mode)
row_group_bytes.title: Row Group Bytes

uri.description: Where the Parquet bytes live. 'inline:dc_<id>' (single-file, resolved against inline_blobs), a bundle-relative path like 'data/<id>.parquet' (static-dir), or an absolute URL (remote). All resolution goes through the runtime's single resolveUri() helper.
uri.title: Uri

DataRef.title: DataRef

Who built the bundle, from where, and against which data.

Surfaced in the bundle's left rail: a bundle outlives the instance it came

dashboard_url.description: Absolute URL of the live dashboard, when the builder knows it

exported_at.description: ISO 8601; mirrors built_at, kept here for display

source.description: Instance the export ran against (host or deployment name)
source.title: Source

payload.description: Exactly what the corresponding api.ts function would have returned

by.description: Grouping key columns; a null key forms its own group

cap_bytes.description: Per-bundle object budget in force at export (raw bytes)

dropped.description: Samples left out because they did not fit the cap (named in the tier detail)

total.description: Objects the collection held at export

ProjectColumnSummary.description:
One column of a collection as its last ingestion recorded it.

The schema the live project page lists (name, dtype, description, distinct
values), so a bundle shows it for every collection of the project, the
ones the export left out included. Statistics other than the distinct
count (min, max, samples of values) stay on the server.

type.description: Column dtype as recorded at ingestion
type.title: Type

ProjectColumnSummary.title: ProjectColumnSummary

ProjectDataCollectionSummary.description:
One data collection of the project. Size comes from ``data_refs`` when the
bundle carries the table; a collection the export left out is still listed,
so a reader can see what the live project holds.

The ingestion facts (rows, columns, size, time, version, format) are what
the live data collection viewer shows; none of them names a location, a
user or a run folder.

size_bytes.description: Stored size at the last ingestion
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

version.description: Delta commit of the last ingestion
version.title: Version

ProjectDataCollectionSummary.title: ProjectDataCollectionSummary

ProjectJoinSummary.description: A top-level join definition: which collections it combines, on what.
ProjectJoinSummary.title: ProjectJoinSummary

ProjectLinkSummary.description:
A cross-collection link (``DCLink``) without its value mappings.

Mappings and patterns are the resolver's working data, can be large, and
the bundle already ships what it needs of them in ``links``; this is the
reader's view of which collection filters which.
ProjectLinkSummary.title: ProjectLinkSummary

ProjectSummary.description:
What a reader can know offline about the dashboard's project.

Producer A reads it from the project document and keeps only display
facts: no permissions, owners, emails, tokens, storage credentials or
server paths. The bundle's project page renders it.

external_url.description: data_management_platform_project_url, kept only when it is http(s)
external_url.title: External Url

project_url.description: Absolute URL of the live project page, when the instance has one
project_url.title: Project Url

run_parameter_files.description: File names the parameters were read from (no paths)
run_parameter_files.title: Run Parameter Files

ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary

ProjectTemplateSummary.description:
The template a project was built from — its id and revision, nothing more.

``TemplateOrigin`` also carries ``data_root``, ``variables`` and a
``config_snapshot``: server paths and storage layout, which a file shared
outside the instance must not leak.
ProjectTemplateSummary.title: ProjectTemplateSummary

ProjectWorkflowSummary.description: One workflow of the project, as a reader names it.

repository_url.description: Public http(s) repository URL; anything else is dropped
repository_url.title: Repository Url

ProjectWorkflowSummary.title: ProjectWorkflowSummary

PythonComponent.description:
A tile the optional Python runtime (Pyodide) recomputes in the browser.

The runtime runs the server's own function for ``job`` over the bundled
table under the current filter mask and answers the tile's request with
it; the frozen payload, when there is one, stays as the fallback (Python
runtime not embedded, failed to boot, or the frame above ``max_rows``).

dc_id.description: The bundled table the job reads (all user columns)
dc_id.title: Dc Id

max_rows.description: Filtered rows above which the runtime serves the frozen payload instead
max_rows.title: Max Rows

spec.description: Job inputs fixed at export (code_figure: code + category colours)
spec.title: Spec

table_uri.description: 'inline:ipc_<dc_id>': the table as Arrow IPC (zstd), for Python — Pyodide's polars is built without its Parquet reader. Same rows and order as the Parquet data_ref, user columns only, so the browser's row mask applies as is
table_uri.title: Table Uri

PythonComponent.title: PythonComponent

map.description: Old column name -> new column name
map.title: Map

ResolvedStructure.description: A structure-resolver answer frozen at export (molecule_3d ``resolve`` mode).
ResolvedStructure.title: ResolvedStructure

RunParameter.description:
One recorded run parameter (``ProvenanceEntry``), as safe to share.

Values that are absolute paths or object-store URIs keep their last part
only (``…/samplesheet.tsv``), and keys that look like credentials have
their value withheld: the parameters say how the data was produced, the
server's directory layout and secrets are not part of that.
RunParameter.title: RunParameter

RuntimeAddon.description:
An optional runtime piece embedded only into bundles that need it.

The base runtime (``static.html``) stays inside its byte budget; a producer
appends an add-on's script when a component needs it, and records it here so
the runtime and the tier table can say what was embedded and why.

bytes.description: Size the add-on adds to the HTML file
bytes.title: Bytes

version.description: Exact version of the embedded add-on
version.title: Version

RuntimeAddon.title: RuntimeAddon

RuntimeLimits.description:
Sampling ceilings the runtime enforces, pinned from the building instance.

Mirrors ``PerformanceConfig`` (settings_models.py): the advanced_viz data
path reduces the filtered frame to ``figure_max_points`` rows under the
kind's policy, and flags aggregating kinds as degraded past
``advanced_viz_no_sample_max_rows``. Defaults match the server defaults so
manifests built before this field existed keep the same behaviour.

advanced_viz_no_sample_max_rows.description: Ceiling past which 'none'-policy kinds are sampled anyway (degraded); 0 disables
advanced_viz_no_sample_max_rows.title: Advanced Viz No Sample Max Rows

advanced_viz_tail_effect_threshold.description: Fallback tail threshold for signed effect columns
advanced_viz_tail_effect_threshold.title: Advanced Viz Tail Effect Threshold

advanced_viz_tail_p_threshold.description: Fallback tail threshold for raw p-value columns
advanced_viz_tail_p_threshold.title: Advanced Viz Tail P Threshold

figure_max_points.description: Scan-level reduction cap (rows) for sampled render paths
figure_max_points.title: Figure Max Points

RuntimeLimits.title: RuntimeLimits

SortOp.description: ``df.sort(by, descending=desc)`` with Polars' default null placement.
SortOp.title: SortOp

TabEntry.description:
One tab of a bundled tab family.

Server-side a family is a main tab (``is_main_tab``) plus children carrying
``parent_dashboard_id``; the viewer's left rail switches between them by
navigating to /dashboard/<id>. A bundle has no routing, so it carries every
tab's document and switches in place.

icon.description: Pill icon: the tab's own tab_icon, else the dashboard's (Iconify id or image path)
icon.title: Icon

main_tab_name.description: Name the rail shows for the main tab (dashboard title otherwise)
main_tab_name.title: Main Tab Name

subtitle.description: One line on what the tab shows (tab links describe it with this)
subtitle.title: Subtitle

tab_group.description: Sidebar section of a child tab; null when ungrouped
tab_group.title: Tab Group

tab_icon.description: The tab's own icon as authored (Iconify id or image path)
tab_icon.title: Tab Icon

tab_order.description: 0 for the main tab, then child order
tab_order.title: Tab Order

TabEntry.title: TabEntry

TierEntry.description: Per-component liveness verdict, shown by ``--check`` and the runtime badge.

detail.description: Human string for the --check table and badge tooltip
detail.title: Detail

TierEntry.title: TierEntry

TierReason.description: Why a component is not fully live. ``detail`` carries the human string.
TierReason.title: TierReason

TraceBinding.description: One trace's binding in the bind-and-refill scheme (RFC §4).

customdata.description: Source columns feeding the 2-D customdata array, in plotly's column order — customdata[k] is this list's k-th column, which is what the hovertemplate's %{customdata[k]} indices address
customdata.title: Customdata

group.description: Equality predicates (grouping column -> value) selecting this trace's rows
group.title: Group

i.description: Trace index in the scaffold figure
i.title: I

TraceBinding.title: TraceBinding

TrendlineBinding.description:
A px trendline trace refit client-side over its raw trace's rows.

``kind`` and ``options`` are px's ``trendline`` / ``trendline_options``; the
binder only emits combinations the runtime ports exactly (anything else
freezes the figure), so the runtime treats an unknown option as a contract
violation.

i.description: Trendline trace index in the scaffold
i.title: I

on.description: Index of the raw-data trace it is fit against
on.title: On

TrendlineBinding.title: TrendlineBinding

on.description: Columns melted into (variable, value) pairs, in block order
on.title: On

value.description: Name of the emitted value column
value.title: Value

variable.description: Name of the emitted variable column
variable.title: Variable

addons.description: Optional runtime add-ons embedded into this bundle's HTML (3Dmol.js, Pyodide)
addons.title: Addons

allow_network_tiles.description: Not read: every bundle keeps a map's own basemap, loaded when the reader is online (depictio/serverless/maps.py); offline the runtime draws the markers on a blank background
allow_network_tiles.title: Allow Network Tiles

depictio_version.description: Depictio version that built the bundle
depictio_version.title: Depictio Version

initial_filters.description: Interactive filters the runtime opens on, in the viewer's InteractiveFilter wire shape (index, value, column_name, interactive_component_type, metadata). Empty = the dashboard's own defaults. A report (the Quarto export's host of the runtime) sets it to the exported analysis state
initial_filters.title: Initial Filters

inline_blobs.description: single-file only: 'dc_<id>' -> base64 Parquet bytes, 'obj_<sha>' -> base64 object bytes, both referenced by inline: URIs
inline_blobs.title: Inline Blobs

limits.description: Sampling ceilings pinned from the building instance's PerformanceConfig

objects.description: indexed_file dc_id -> the objects shipped for it (structures, PAE matrices), read at export from the collection's storage under a stated cap
objects.title: Objects

project.description: The dashboard's project as the bundle's project page shows it (producer A); null when the producer has no project to describe

prologues.description: component_id -> code-mode prologue IR (phase 6): the ops the runtime replays on the filtered frame before bind-and-refill. Absent for components whose code needs no reshape (they bind to the base table)
prologues.title: Prologues

python_components.description: component_id -> the Python job the Pyodide add-on runs for it (present only when the add-on is embedded)
python_components.title: Python Components

resolved_structures.description: Structure-resolver answers frozen at export (molecule_3d resolve mode)
resolved_structures.title: Resolved Structures

tabs.description: Every tab of the bundled family, main tab first, each with its own document. Empty for a single-tab bundle, where `dashboard` is the whole story; when populated it includes the entry tab too, so `dashboard.doc` duplicates one entry. Component-keyed sections (tiers, frozen, bindings, prologues) span the whole family — component ids are uuids, so they never collide across tabs
tabs.title: Tabs
